tools.name: Claude

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.tagline: OpenAI's assistant for productivity, writing, research and analysis

tools.name: Codex
tools.tagline: OpenAI's coding agent that works with your ChatGPT plan
tools.description: Turn written specifications into working software with Codex: repository context, implementation tasks, debugging, code review and delivery workflows using your own ChatGPT account.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.tagline: Google's multimodal AI across the Google ecosystem
tools.description: Learn Gemini for research, multimodal work and productivity, including Google Workspace workflows in Docs, Sheets, Gmail and Drive.

tools.name: Cursor
tools.tagline: The AI code editor for serious development work
tools.description: Work faster inside Cursor: Tab completions, Agent mode, codebase understanding, rules files, multi-file changes and debugging real projects.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.tagline: AI pair programming inside your IDE and GitHub
tools.description: Use Copilot completions, Copilot Chat, the coding agent and AI code review across your development workflow on GitHub.

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.description: Run source-grounded research: market research, competitive analysis, fact-finding and structured research reports with citations you can verify.

tools.name: NotebookLM
tools.tagline: Google's source-grounded research and study assistant
tools.description: Ground AI in your own documents: upload sources, ask grounded questions, synthesize across documents and build reliable knowledge workflows.

tools.name: AI Image Tools
tools.tagline: Midjourney, GPT image, Ideogram, Flux and Firefly
tools.description: Prompt, iterate and produce professional images: product shots, marketing visuals, brand assets and creative workflows across the major image models.

tools.name: AI Video Tools
tools.tagline: Sora, Veo, Runway and the text-to-video landscape
tools.description: Learn practical text-to-video production: prompting for motion, shot planning, iteration and where AI video genuinely helps professional work.

tools.name: Automation & Agents
tools.tagline: MCP, agent workflows, Zapier, Make and n8n
tools.description: Connect AI to your real systems: Model Context Protocol, agentic workflows, cross-tool automation and safe deployment of AI agents in business processes.

tools.name: HTML
tools.tagline: The structure language of every web page — learn it from zero to expert
tools.description: A complete, no-shortcuts HTML curriculum: document structure, every element family, links, images, tables, forms, media, semantic markup, accessibility, SEO metadata, graphics and browser APIs. Every lesson pairs full theory with a built-in code editor and live preview so you practice as you read.
